proofReview.palindrome: A multiset admits a palindrome iff at most one letter has odd multiplicity. Necessity follows from mirrored pairs; sufficiency follows by placing half of each count on both sides with any odd letter in the center.
proofReview.pathMask: XOR of root-to-endpoint parity masks cancels their common prefix and equals parity on the unique connecting path. Legal pairs therefore have equal masks or differ in exactly one bit.
proofReview.counting: Reference queries only previously inserted nodes before inserting the current node. Its27 masks are distinct, each eligible unordered pair is counted once, and no self-pair is inserted prematurely.
proofReview.complexityAndSafety: Iterative traversal O(n), expected O(26n) hash lookup work and O(n) storage. Runtime-seeded SplitMix64 reduces fixed-hash adversarial collision risk without claiming deterministic worst-case lookup bounds. Masks use26 bits; counts and total use64 bits. Maximum4999950000 exceeds signed32-bit.
proofReview.bindings: Normalized import schema and frozen checksum verified, including promoted batch checksum. Displayed editorial and solution arrays equal batch artifacts; displayed C++ exactly equals frozen reference. Required correctness-proof heading present.

independentVerification.smallMethod: From every source, traverse all unique paths with an explicit26-element letter-count array, then count odd frequencies at larger-numbered endpoints. No root masks or reference hash counting used.
independentVerification.largeCasesMethod: Root at the last vertex, sort all parity masks and group equal values. Add within-group combinations. For each bit, split groups by bit0/1, clear that bit from the1-side, and use a two-pointer merge of sorted groups to count matching cross-group products. No hash lookups, no online insert/query flow, and no author oracle calls.
independentVerification.sharedTheoryDisclosure: Large independent validation shares the proven parity characterization but uses a different root and deterministic sorted merge counting. Small explicit letter-path counts independently validate that characterization against actual original paths.
